name: jyu_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite of a huge, heavy, burly paint monster shaped like a bear man, exactly the character in the front and side view references: brown paint body with large cream marble blotches, very broad shoulders, thick arms, a big round belly, thick legs, small round ears, a short spiky cream tuft of hair on top, a cream muzzle, a round glossy black nose, the space between the nose and the mouth plain smooth cream, thick dark eyebrows, half-lidded stern eyes, the mouth slightly open with small fangs, cream paint dripping from the mouth and chin, paint dripping from the hands, straight human-shaped legs with bare human feet and small paint puddles at the feet, arms hanging at his sides. Three-quarter view facing left, standing idle pose. Same pixel art style and size as the reference crocodile sprite: dark outline, glossy highlights, drips.
